citation.title: Learning topology optimization process via convolutional long‐short‐term memory autoencoder‐decoder
citation.authors: Qiaochu Ma, Edward C. DeMeter, Saurabh Basu
citation.venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering 124(11) (2023) 2571-2588 (Crossref; hybrid open access, CC BY 4.0 per Crossref and OpenAlex)
citation.version_coded: none: only the abstract was read (pool record from OpenAlex). The version of record could not be retrieved

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no accessible full text). Abstract only: a ConvLSTM encoder-decoder, fed the first SIMP iterations, predicts the rest of the optimization path, claiming a large computation-cost reduction for a small loss in design performance.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded; the abstract gives no numbers.
claim.alternatives: Abstract: the training data are SIMP runs with random boundary conditions, loads and volume constraints; the method is said to extend to unseen boundary and load conditions.

notes: Access attempts on 2026-09-24, all with a generic User-Agent and no personal data: (1) the open copy OpenAlex lists, onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/pdfdirect/10.1002/nme.7221: HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge page (curl); the challenge was not attempted. Pointer from the abstract: the speed claim is qualitative (significant reduction in computation cost with a little sacrifice in optimum performance), and the comparator is SIMP, which also generates the data; the full text decides the primary outcome and stratum. Related but distinct study by the same first author in the pool: P00883 (TO-NODE, IJNME 2024); not a duplicate. Screening code was I-SPEED. No author named Jun Wang.
